metadata.title: Purely cosmetic surgeries on knots with low-span Jones polynomials, II
metadata.abstract: We show that a knot in the 3-sphere with a nontrivial Jones polynomial of span at most 14 admits no purely cosmetic surgery. This extends a result of the first author for span at most 11. We determine all Laurent polynomials of span 15 satisfying the conditions on the Jones polynomial used in the proof. These polynomials form an infinite family. We also show that a knot of braid index at most 4 whose Jones polynomial has odd span admits no purely cosmetic surgery.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Jones span≤14 的 cosmetic surgery 排除
analysis.workSummary: 证明 nontrivial knot 的 Jones span≤14 时没有 purely cosmetic surgery，给 span15 的 polynomial 判据和无限族，并处理 braid index≤4 的 odd span 情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩大已知 span≤11 的排除范围。
analysis.limitations: span15 使用附加判据，不能说全部 span≤15 均已排除。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude 与 ChatGPT 用于核查计算、论证及改善表述，并对全文负责。
